description: One violation of each strict ES-D ruling, one per line. Each line names the exact registry id the strict profile emits and the ES-D decision it witnesses. Every line is verified against lintEars with the strict dialect.

lines.text: WHEN a payment webhook is received, the billing service shall verify the HMAC signature.

lines.ruling: ES-D-002 then keyword required in unwanted behaviour

lines.text: When a payment webhook is received, when a refund is requested, the billing service shall issue a refund.
lines.ruling: ES-D-003 one trigger maximum (two When clauses)

lines.text: When a payment webhook is received, it shall verify the HMAC signature.
lines.ruling: ES-D-005 one system name, no pronoun reference

lines.text: While the payment provider is unavailable, the billing service shall shall queue retryable events.
lines.ruling: ES-D-008 one requirement per line (second shall outside an and-joined response)
